description: This file defines an interface for a controlled transaction fault injector in the Orleans Transactions Test Kit, extending the ITransactionFaultInjector interface and including properties to control fault injection timing.

classes.name: IControlledTransactionFaultInjector
classes.description: Interface for a controlled transaction fault injector, providing properties to specify fault injection before and after store operations.

methods.name: InjectBeforeStore
methods.description: Boolean property indicating whether to inject a fault before the store operation.

methods.name: InjectAfterStore
methods.description: Boolean property indicating whether to inject a fault after the store operation.
